confidence_notes: I ran two searches: one for the RBA rate and one for El Nido prices. The RBA search gave conflicting figures. The overview page and RSS feed show 0.6720 for 18 Nov 2026, while a table lists 0.6677 for 19 Nov but carries odd age metadata. I used the 0.6720 figure from 18 Nov. Food and drink anchors come from aggregated price guides (Gotripzi, Whereandwhen, Tripbase) that disagree and are not dated precisely. Beer is a tourist-venue restaurant price, between the local draft and imported-bottle figures. Cocktail rests on one generic guide figure of about $5, adjusted to roughly 2.5 times beer. Wine by the glass is assumed from the beer relationship because I found no direct data. Accommodation is a holistic estimate from general knowledge, not from any live listings. El Nido prices vary a lot by season and by venue.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other Philippine island tourist hubs such as Boracay and Siargao, and with Southeast Asian beach destinations such as Koh Tao and Gili Trawangan. El Nido has tourist-inflated prices relative to mainland Philippines.
